editorial:
Ever wonder how a movie actually comes together behind the scenes? You get a front-row seat to the magic in this documentary. It follows director Spike Jonze and his team as they build the world of the movie Her. You will see how they designed the colorful city, how the actors worked with a voice that wasn't actually there, and how they made a futuristic world feel like it could be real tomorrow. It feels less like a boring school lesson and more like hanging out with a group of creative people who are obsessed with their work. 

What really stands out is how the film shows the trial and error process. You see the mistakes and the small wins, which makes the final movie feel even more special. The pacing is steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you aren't into production design. If you love movies or just like seeing how art is made, you need to see this. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a real collector, adding the Blu-ray to your shelf is the way to go for the best quality.
endingExplained: The documentary wraps up by showing the finished product of the movie Her. It concludes with the team reflecting on the emotional journey they went through. You see the final scenes of the film and hear the creators talk about whether they achieved their original vision. It ends on a thoughtful note, showing that while the project is over, the ideas about love and technology stay with the crew and the audience.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves seeing how movies are made.
